Download and extract uvr binary

dot-get_and_extract_binary.Rd

Download and extract uvr binary

Usage

.get_and_extract_binary(download_url, dest_dir, timeout = 60)

Arguments

timeout

Download timeout in seconds (default 60, matching utils::download.file()). Increase on slow connections, e.g. install_uvr(timeout = 300). The R session's timeout option is restored on exit.

Value

Destination path or NULL if download failed. A download that hits the timeout errors instead of returning NULL, so the caller does not fall through to the misleading "no pre-built binary" path.
